listing.name: Super Mario Bros. 35 (sm35recomp)
listing.summary: Experimental SMM2-derived AArch64 to C static runtime Metal/Vulkan. Upstream maturity: Two-player Mac+iPad matching-to-ranking tests; long many-player/Windows/Linux hardware untested. One device per internet connection per match limitation. Acquisition: Official launcher/recompiler packages build locally; Nextendo community sign-in/server, not Nintendo. Platforms: Actual Mac15+ Apple Silicon, Windows x64 AVX2, Linux x64 AVX2/aarch64 packages. Windows/Linux real hardware untested. iOS source played; Android source untried. Original data: Own base plus1.0.2 update, prod.keys and firmware; NSP/XCI or extracted ExeFS/RomFS. Version checked. Current legal acquisition availability not established; owned dump only. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
